Name: Fourth Wall Confectioner
Author: CosmicSweetpea
Description:
[b]Fourth Wall Confectioner by CosmicSweetpea[/b]

Inspired by my favorite movie of all time as a child, I had to break an Oompa Loompa through Stardew Valley’s fourth wall, give him a candy shop, and let him sell highly questionable confectionery equipment every Friday. You’re welcome.
[heading]Visit Wally[/heading]
Wally’s invisible portal appears in Pelican Town every Friday. Because not everybody can access the 4th dimension and you know it.
Shop Hours: 10:00 AM - 8:00 PM step into the main circle in town, then open the chest beside Wally to browse his shop. Be sure to speak with him as well because Wally has two special quests that unlock the mod’s confectionery machines and chocolate cooking collection.
[heading]Confectionery Quests[/heading]
[b]Proof of Confection[/b]
Bring Wally one Chocolate Cake on a Friday.
[b]Completing the quest unlocks[/b]
[list]
[*]The Bonbon Reactor[/*]
[*]All seven farmhouse chocolate recipes[/*]
[*]Cocoa Powder in Wally’s shop[/*]
[/list][b]Proof of Pastry[/b]
Bring Wally one Strange Bun on a Friday.
[b]Completing the quest unlocks[/b]
[list]
[*]The Puffworks Press[/*]
[/list][heading]Magical Candy Machines[/heading]
The Bonbon Reactor and Puffworks Press transform selected ingredients into unique confectionery items.
Every machine recipe requires:
[list]
[*]One approved ingredient[/*]
[*]One Golden Ticket (available from Wally)[/*]
[/list]Golden Tickets can be purchased from Wally for 100g.
Each confection takes 180 in game minutes to process.
[heading]Seven Chocolate Recipes[/heading]
Complete Proof of Confection to immediately learn all seven recipes:
[list]
[*]Cranberry Ganache Tart[/*]
[*]Firework Truffle[/*]
[*]Chocolate Cream Puff[/*]
[*]Chocolate-Covered Strawberry[/*]
[*]Fourth Wall Fudge[/*]
[*]Chocolate Rose[/*]
[*]Chocolate River Truffle Trio[/*]
[/list]Cocoa Powder becomes available from Wally after the quest is completed.
[heading]Wally’s Shop[/heading]
The confectionery carries a growing collection of strange and colorful merchandise, including:
[list]
[*]Everlasting Gobstopper[/*]
[*]Wally Bar[/*]
[*]Golden Tickets[/*]
[*]Cocoa Powder[/*]
[*]Three Course Chew[/*]
[*]Bad Egg Bonbon[/*]
[*]Won’t Stay Grounded Tonic[/*]
[*]Golden Ticket Crunch[/*]
[*]Confectionery clothing and 2 hats[/*]
[*]Candy themed furniture[/*]
[*]Rugs, lamps, and wallpapers[/*]
[/list]Some products are sold directly, while others must be created using Wally’s machines.
